cases.name: smoothing43
argv: import os,sys,json; from pathlib import Path; from tools.quantized_optimizers.score_dense import read_checkpoint_file; base=Path(sys.argv[1]); p=list(base.rglob("iter_000015/model.pt")); assert len(p)==1; curve=json.loads((base.parent/"diagnostics/task_curve.jsonl").read_text().splitlines()[-1]); assert curve["step"]==15; pin=read_checkpoint_file(p[0]); Path(sys.argv[2]).write_text(json.dumps(pin,indent=2)); os.execvp(sys.argv[3],sys.argv[3:]+["--checkpoint",str(p[0].parent),"--checkpoint-sha256",pin["sha256"],"--expected-substantive-nll",repr(curve["substantive_validation"]["val/loss_avg"])])
